title: Hatsune Miku — Even What You Don't Want To Hear〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Even What You Don't Want To Hear（4★）

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Miku.
Are you guys done with practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We found a good place to stop, so I came to help out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I really appreciate that. And will it be a cafe au lait for you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, iced, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Practice went just fine but...
I can't help, but wonder...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (For a while now, it seems like An hasn't been at 100%.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But they did just perform in a big event. I suppose anyone would want to relax a little after something like that.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (At the same time, she seems bothered by something. So much so that Akito's begun to take notice.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something bothering you, Miku? I hardly ever see you like this. Anyway, here's your cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, MEIKO...?
Have either An or Akito come to talk to you recently? Did they seem bothered by anything?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An and Akito?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. An seems bothered by something and Akito seems to be worried about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I really can't say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I didn't expect to hear that An's name when you first started talking.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was surprised too. I always figured that An would ask her teammates when she needed help figuring out something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. That was also exactly the case when she was trying to get Kohane to believe in herself more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She tried talking to me, her father, Akito and Toya about it. Pretty much everybody she could.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right, and I think that's one of An's best qualities.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But something feels different this time around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Could it simply be that it has nothing to do with us, music or her team...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I seem to only ever see that look of concern on her face whenever she's practicing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Akito probably became worried because it has everything to do with their music and team.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Not only that, she looks even worse whenever Kohane's name comes up in conversation.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if it's something like this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's something she can't tell her teammates.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, don't kid with me. You know what I'm talking about, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She could be afraid of letting her teammates down or them not understanding her problems.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everybody has their reasons.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, it could also be that she doesn't know how to talk about what she's feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, how?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She might not quite know how to describe or explain whatever she's going through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But the possibility that An wants to resolve this on her own isn't zero.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's still my expectation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're that worried about her, why not just ask her yourself?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'd like to keep observing for a little while longer...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like you said, there are still other possibilities out there and we don't know everything yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even Akito's still just watching and refraining from interjecting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So for now, I should probably just be patient.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since what one of them does affects the entire team, this may've just been an inevitability.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I really can't say what's bothering An, but I sure hope she finds a good way to get through this.)
